## One task at a time

An AI workspace is easier to use when each tool does one understandable job. Summarize a passage, translate a paragraph, or explore a new visual direction.

Keep the input limits visible and the provider errors honest. Generated output is a starting point, not a guarantee. The person using the result remains part of the process.
